verdict.rationale: Orb is API-first with multi-language SDKs and supports scripted actions (subscription creation, alerts, event ingestion, idempotent retries) that could be invoked from CI/automation scripts, and docs mention testing pricing changes before deploying. However there is no explicit CLI, headless mode, or CI/automation integration documented — everything is inferred from generic API/SDK availability. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or headless runner, explicit CI/pipeline integration guide, and evidence of automated test/staging workflows beyond the vague 'test pricing changes' mention.
